_scope_note: Bayesian-optimisation arm of the test-split reference, at the SAME budget (64 per tunable family, 257 objective calls per record) as the sobol_local arm. The point is a like-for-like comparison of search algorithms at equal cost: if BO clearly beats sobol_local then the search row in the comparison table was a weak baseline and must be replaced; if it does not, that is evidence the baseline is not a straw man. Like the sobol arm this is ONLINE ADAPTATION -- true outcomes are consulted per instance -- and nothing is fitted or tuned on these rows.
